summary.intent: Review findings from caliper/65 and related trail discussions and local review runs, then publish the finished checker-bug branches and begin fixing the review findings in shape detection.
summary.outcome: Pushed and linked the checker-bug branches and set bodies on PRs 325 and 326. Launched an agent to fix the review findings in shape detection, including a panic in merged product code. The fix is not yet confirmed complete.

repo: Review findings for caliper/65 were not all read initially. Three unread findings turned out to be real bugs in already-merged product code, one of them a panic.
Shape detection code has outstanding review findings that need fixing.
Checker-bug work is split across separate branches that map to PRs (including 325 and 326), which need to be pushed and linked.
workflow: Read all review findings, trail discussions and local review runs before answering, since unread findings can hide real bugs.
Push finished branches and set PR bodies before starting new fix work, so completed work is not blocked by the new task.
Delegating the fix to a sub-agent allows the review-finding work to proceed separately from the branch publishing.
